# SEOGlint

> SEOGlint is a free SEO, GEO, AEO, AIO and SXO audit tool. Paste a page's HTML or enter a URL, and it scans for classic SEO, technical health, and AI-search readiness — returning a 0–100 score, per-check evidence, and ready-to-paste fixes.

## Core
- [SEOGlint home](https://www.seoglint.com/): the audit tool — scan any page for SEO, technical, and GEO/AEO readiness.

## What it checks
- On-Page SEO: title, meta description, headings, image alt text, canonical, Open Graph, mobile viewport, language.
- Technical & schema: JSON-LD structured data, Organization/entity markup, and whether core content lives in the raw HTML.
- GEO / AEO / AIO (AI Optimization): AI-crawler access (GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, etc.), llms.txt, answer-first content, question-style headings, extractable content, FAQ schema, and freshness signals.

## Free SEO tools
- [Free SEO tools hub](https://www.seoglint.com/free-seo-tools.html): all free SEO, schema, sitemap, robots.txt and AI search tools.
- [Robots.txt generator and checker](https://www.seoglint.com/robots-txt-generator.html): build and test a valid robots.txt, including AI crawler rules.
- [Sitemap.xml generator](https://www.seoglint.com/sitemap-generator.html) and [sitemap checker](https://www.seoglint.com/sitemap-checker.html): create and validate an XML sitemap.
- [Schema markup generator](https://www.seoglint.com/schema-generator.html), [FAQ schema generator](https://www.seoglint.com/faq-schema-generator.html) and [schema markup validator](https://www.seoglint.com/schema-markup-validator.html): create and check JSON-LD.
- [Meta tag generator](https://www.seoglint.com/meta-tag-generator.html) and [OG meta tags checker](https://www.seoglint.com/open-graph-preview.html): meta title, description and Open Graph tags.
- [llms.txt generator](https://www.seoglint.com/llms-txt-generator.html) and [AI visibility checker](https://www.seoglint.com/ai-visibility-checker.html): prepare for AI search.
- [Core Web Vitals checker](https://www.seoglint.com/core-web-vitals-checker.html): find LCP and CLS issues.

## Blog
- [SEOGlint Blog](https://www.seoglint.com/blog.html): weekly SEO, GEO and AEO tips and guides.
- [Why Is My Website Not Showing Up on Google? 7 Fixes With Real Search Console Data](https://www.seoglint.com/blog/website-not-showing-on-google.html): How to tell indexing problems from ranking problems, with a status-based troubleshooter, printable checklist and real Search Console observations.
- [12 JSON-LD and Schema Markup Mistakes: Real Tests and Fixes](https://www.seoglint.com/blog/json-ld-schema-errors-tested.html): 12 flawed JSON-LD snippets tested in the SEOGlint validator, with screenshots, observed messages and proposed fixes.
- [Google AI Search 2026: 9 Ways to Rank in AI Overviews](https://www.seoglint.com/blog/google-ai-search-2026-how-to-rank.html): how to get your website cited in Google AI Overviews, AI Mode, and generative search results.
- [How to Get Cited by AI Search Engines](https://www.seoglint.com/blog/how-to-get-cited-by-ai-search-engines.html): 7 actionable fixes to get your site cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini.

## About
- Free to use. The audit runs in the browser; live URL scanning uses a lightweight serverless backend.
- Topics: SEO, GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), AIO (AI Optimization), AI search visibility, llms.txt, structured data.
